name: Evos Rising
source:
Being the son of one of the leading Geneticist on the planet, your younger years were been spent studying to succeed him, till one day a breaking news report announced that there are Evolved humans (Evos) among us and you're one of them!

What will you do with these newly awoken powers?
That's entirely up to you!

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/evos-rising-game-154164004]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
作为地球上一位顶尖遗传学家的儿子，你年轻的时候一直在学习以接替他，直到有一天，一则突发新闻报道宣布我们中间有进化人类（Evos），而你就是其中之一！

你会用这些新觉醒的力量做什么？
这完全取决于你！

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/evos-rising-game-154164004]Patreon[/url]]
